Home / Map Route Animator
Free tool · No sign-up

Animate your route on a map

Add the places, pick how you travelled, and get an explainer-style map video with a moving route, highlighted countries and labels. Export it for YouTube, Reels or Shorts. Everything runs in your browser.

Preview

Stops

Type a city or country, or click anywhere on the map to drop a point. The transport is how you travel to that stop.

    Style

    How it works

    The map is drawn on your device from open country outlines, so nothing is uploaded and there's no watermark. Flights curve along the shortest path over the globe, the way real planes fly; cars, trains and ships travel in straight lines on the map. The camera eases from one leg to the next, and every country you pass through can be highlighted.

    Exporting records the animation in real time, so a 20-second animation takes 20 seconds to export. Keep this tab open and visible while it records. Chrome and Edge save WebM or MP4; Safari saves MP4.

    Questions

    Is the video free to use on YouTube?

    Yes. The map outlines come from Natural Earth, which is in the public domain, city locations come from GeoNames (CC BY 4.0), and there is no watermark. Use the videos in monetised videos, Reels and Shorts.

    Which places can I use?

    Every country, plus more than 24,000 towns and cities worldwide with at least 15,000 people. Type at least two letters to see suggestions. Add a country code to pick between places with the same name, like "Hyderabad, PK". For a smaller place, click the exact spot on the map and rename the stop.

    Why did my export come out as WebM?

    Some browsers can only record WebM. YouTube accepts WebM directly; for Instagram, open it in CapCut or any editor and export as MP4, or use Safari, which records MP4.

    Can I use it for history videos?

    Yes. Add the places in order, turn on country highlights and set a title such as "Napoleon's march, 1812" for a classic explainer look.
